Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Derby for 2026, and here is what he found: 4 family events, 3 of them free. The magic runs from December 5 (Derby Christmas Parade) through December 18 (Santa's Workshop), with Breakfast with Santa at Christmas in the Park and Santa's Village at Christmas in the Park (both December 12) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Derby
